query_plan.query: What is the average life expectancy in countries with a population greater than 50 million?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by country, then compute the average life expectancy.
steps.query: Return all countries with a population greater than 50 million. Also return their life expectancy.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(countries.life_expectancy) AS avg_life_expectancy FROM countries WHERE countries.population > 50000000

s1.sql_query: SELECT countries.country, countries.life_expectancy, countries.name FROM countries WHERE countries.population > 50000000
